Thanks Ellen — and thanks Grace for the handoff. A couple of finance items before we can finalize the PO destination: 

- Confirm that Greenline UK Ltd is the payee for this PO and that invoices will be raised to that legal name.
- Please confirm the VAT registration number (you listed GB999888777 — please confirm that exact value matches Companies House/VAT record).
- We require either a government letter or a bank statement showing the company name and address OR a certified Companies House printout for entity proof. The incorporation PDF is fine but please confirm it's a certified copy (stamped/signed) — if not, a Companies House verification link will work.
- For cross-border payments we need IBAN and SWIFT. Please indicate currency preference for the invoice (GBP/EUR/USD).

Note on withholding: since this is payment to a non-US entity with a valid W-8BEN-E, Redwood will not withhold US backup withholding. We still need the completed and signed W-8BEN-E on file that matches the payee name on your invoices.

Once we have these items, Rafael will remove the PO hold and Finance will issue the PO to Greenline UK Ltd.

Thanks,
